findings: The effect description is shown for arbitrary inspected actors through Game targetmode SHOW_CHARACTER_SHEET_CURSOR -> CharacterSheet.new(target) -> self.actor -> e.long_desc(player,p). The localized subject 你 is therefore ambiguous for an NPC effect; 目标 is accurate for both players and NPCs.
The literal space preceding %s produces 物理伤害 。 when silence is absent.
rejected_subclaim: Localized fragment 并被沉默 has no pronoun; the claim of mixing third-person Chinese in %s was unsupported.
